astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: Leaving Earth
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: What would it look like to leave planet Earth? Such an event was recorded visually in great detail by the MESSENGER spacecraft as it swung back past the Earth in 2005 on its way in toward the planet Mercury.
